name: dempsey
description: Andrew Dempsey's Claude Code skills and mods.

plugins.name: dempsey-skills
plugins.description: Brainstorm (a BMad CIS fork around a user-owned technique catalog), archify and excalidraw diagrams, security-preflight, and mp-night-shift for unattended ticket runs.

plugins.name: helper-desk
plugins.description: Helper Desk: a purple task progress bar above the prompt that moves as each to-do item is done, and a side pane with one live card per subagent. Originally from Ben AI (benai.co).

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Counts down until the chat's prompt cache goes cold, above the prompt, with a Keep warm button. Originally from Ben AI (benai.co).

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: At a configurable token threshold (default 250k), offers Refresh: writes a handoff of the whole chat and starts a fresh chat with it. Originally from Ben AI (benai.co).

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: When you correct Claude, offers to save the fix as a lasting rule in CLAUDE.md, in the current project, or in a rules folder you choose. Originally from Ben AI (benai.co).

plugins.name: chat-inventory
plugins.description: A side pane, In this chat, that lists the to-do list, connectors, context files and skills this chat used. Originally from Ben AI (benai.co).

plugins.name: mods
plugins.description: A Mods pane that finds every mod on this Mac by itself, also the ones installed from a marketplace, turns each one on or off in every chat, and opens the side-pane ones. Originally from Ben AI (benai.co).
